sections.text_helper: Section 49.8.4 "CRYP data output register (CRYP_DOUTR)" in chapter 49 (Cryptographic processor (CRYP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2397.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 DOUT[31:0]: Data output
A four-fold sequential read to this bitfield during the output phase results in retrieving a
complete 16-byte block from the CRYP output FIFO. From the first to the fourth read, the
corresponding data weights are [127:96], [95:64], [63:32], and [31:0].
Output FIFO can store up to two 16-byte blocks of plaintext (when decrypting) or ciphertext
(when encrypting).
When the output FIFO is empty a read returns an undefined value. Writes are ignored.
